name: PerformanceHQ
oneLiner: PerformanceHQ is the one place your training, policies, surveys, mystery shops and reputation data live together — so your team stops reconciling systems and starts acting on what matters.
pitch: PerformanceHQ is the unified platform that brings all of Grace Hill's solutions — training, policies, surveys, mystery shopping, reputation — into one place, then connects the data across them so operators can see what's actually driving performance. Instead of logging into five systems and manually reconciling spreadsheets, teams get one role-based experience, one set of connected analytics, and AI tools that cut administrative work. It's positioned as the decision layer: PMS platforms record what happened; PerformanceHQ tells you what to focus on.

name: Intelligence+
oneLiner: Intelligence+ reads every resident comment, tells you exactly what to fix first, and with Ask Gracie™ anyone on your team can just ask a question in plain English and get a sourced answer in seconds.
pitch: Intelligence+ is the AI-powered intelligence layer inside PerformanceHQ. It reads every resident survey comment, organizes the feedback into 13 categories, and surfaces the trends, risks, and wins that matter — then attaches a specific recommendation and a trackable action plan to each one. With Ask Gracie™, anyone on the team can type a plain-language question about a property, region, or portfolio and get a direct, sourced answer in seconds. And when a performance gap surfaces, Intelligence+ recommends the right Grace Hill course and assigns it in one click from the insight card. That's the loop no other platform closes.
